archive_path_basis: All relative paths are relative to proposal_root; root chooses the inert docs destination. No active repository or product file was edited.

selection_policy.goal: Smallest evidence-complete checkpoint of final proposals, frozen expectations, reproduction sources, source traces, final receipts and meaningful first failures/counters.
selection_policy.duplicates: Archive each SHA256 content once; logical aliases reference canonical content. Materialize alias paths only if later reproducing a receipt/tool requires them.
selection_policy.excluded: __pycache__, bytecode, node_modules/dependencies, runtime DB/images, temporary fragments, empty routine stderr, redundant successful stdout, superseded intermediate attempts already covered by final results and preserved first red.
selection_policy.no_action_authorized: No installer execution, Native database startup/query, product edit or assertion that OW04 is complete is authorized by this plan.

known_blockers_and_limits.detail: Admission01 and UI READY universal non-null floor were withdrawn. Real net0/HPP0 SALE and RETURN can have no journal. DATED actual ancestors retain their real books; known causal absence must be separately proven and never filled with a fake date.

Genuine free SALE/noJ then accepted recost can produce a new refund0 HPP-only RETURN journal. Prior causal SALE/RETURN absence does not imply projected NO_JOURNAL. Do not use unrelated HPP-sync/funding books as the causal floor; current cumulative Native HPP and lawful date projection remain required.

Seal protected prior ancestor/projection proof at native_return_enter while own row is DRAFT. AH marks RETURN POSTED and freezes HPP before its new journal call, so completed return_fact/causal info cannot authorize that in-flight row. Exact own-scope projection exclusion and projected-to-actual random UUID binding are still owning integration.

No public quote/settle API or complete coordinator is implemented. Preserve inner request preclaim-before-FG, exact low owner/ACL/RLS capabilities and post-wait/replay authority. Do not infer postgres RLS bypass or broaden Native context admission.

Old unregistered returns lack immutable total family order/replay header facts. NEW_POST requires a protected serialized immutable assignment receipt. Qualified LEGACY_BASE/backfill remains a direction, not an implemented permissive fallback.

Full actual U/apply/restore collector, source-plan semantic verifier, operation provenance/materializer, protected pending-plan versus prior-I binding, future joint capacity, nonnegative AR/E checks, complete canonical consumers/detectors and consumer undo remain integration requirements. Signed zero-current cohorts and >Native-line components cannot be collapsed or capped.

Final closure must prove actual objects/receipts/status/account/cash/both-date profiles without live contexts or reauthorizing a recorded actor at COMMIT. Whole Native copy/capture/verify/restore and actual Native/RLS/HTTP/race/browser runtime verification are unexecuted for OW04. Archive is inert, not a half-install or paid-feature completion.

ui/RESULT.json reports 40 synthetic tests passing and its referenced hashes match current files, but ui/final-tests.log is only66 bytes of Vitest RUN header, with no test/result summary. Preserve the self-reported receipt plus exact log without upgrading it to corroborated test execution. Empty typecheck stdout similarly relies on the reported receipt exit status.
